items.title: Fixed-pattern ILU(0) factorization and application
items.statement: Define a fixed-order, exact-field ILU(0) procedure on a canonical sorted CSR matrix. It checks missing diagonals and zero pivots, updates only positions retained in the input pattern, returns the unit-lower and upper factors on success, and applies them by forward and backward substitution.
items.strategy: Specify the input domain, structural pattern, validation and pivot branches, exact nested recurrence, returned factor slots, and triangular-solve application. Make no convergence or accuracy claim.

items.title: ILU(0) factor slots, setup work, and application work
items.statement: Prove finite termination with a status; on success, the stored strict-lower and upper factor slots stay within the input pattern, the factor storage uses exactly the input's canonical stored-entry count, setup arithmetic is counted by actual pattern intersections, and applying the factors uses two triangular solves with an exact sparse-entry operation count. The claim concerns the factor slots, not the product LU.
items.strategy: Induct through the declared row-wise updates to establish the retained factor slots; count each pivot division and each matching pattern-intersection update; then derive the two triangular-solve counts from their coordinate recurrences.

items.title: Flexible GMRES with variable right preconditioning
items.statement: Define a bounded exact-arithmetic flexible GMRES run for a finite-dimensional complex system, with a possibly changing right-preconditioning action at every step, a modified Gram–Schmidt Arnoldi relation, a small least-squares minimization, and explicit zero-residual, breakdown, and budget-exhaustion branches.
items.strategy: Specify the input data, per-step preconditioner interface, orthogonalization recurrence, stored preconditioned vectors, minimizer selection, statuses, and finite budget. State no convergence guarantee.

items.title: Flexible GMRES minimizes over the actual preconditioned-vector span
items.statement: For every nonbreakdown m-step run of the variable-right-preconditioned flexible GMRES algorithm, the Arnoldi relation identifies each true residual with its small least-squares residual; any small least-squares minimizer produces a true-residual minimizer over x0 + span{z1,…,zm}, without a fixed-preconditioner spectral or convergence claim.
items.strategy: Prove orthonormality and the columnwise Arnoldi relation by induction from modified Gram–Schmidt, assemble AZm=V_{m+1} Hbar_m, establish the norm identity, and transfer least-squares minimizers to the actual affine span.

title: Preconditioner algorithms and residual metrics — Examples

items.title: A small left-preconditioned residual can hide a large physical residual
items.statement: For any ordered field F and 0<epsilon<1, the scalar system A=[1], M=[epsilon^-1], b=[1], x=0 has physical residual absolute value 1 and left-preconditioned residual absolute value epsilon.
items.strategy: Apply the exact left-residual map and the ordered-field absolute-value definition to the specified scalar residuals.

items.title: ILU(0) factors of a three-row tridiagonal matrix
items.statement: For A=[[4,-1,0],[-1,4,-1],[0,-1,4]] in the fixed natural order, the fixed-pattern ILU(0) procedure returns the displayed exact unit-lower and upper factors, whose product is A.
items.strategy: Run the specified recurrence row by row and multiply the resulting triangular factors exactly.

items.title: The product of ILU(0) factors can contain a fill position
items.statement: The fixed-pattern ILU(0) factor slots do not imply that every nonzero of LU lies in the input matrix pattern.
items.strategy: Apply the exact three-row recurrence and exhibit one nonzero product entry at an input zero position.
